fonts.display: 'Gilroy', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Gilroy', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Deep Iris
palette.role: Page canvas, hero background, primary surface — the brand-defining midnight violet that sets the entire dark mode identity

palette.name: Iris Shadow
palette.role: Elevated card surfaces on dark canvas, secondary card backgrounds — one step lighter than canvas for depth without breaking the violet atmosphere

palette.name: Iris Glow
palette.role: Mid-tone accent surface, footer background, highlighted metric blocks — mid-violet for tertiary elevation and accent fills

palette.name: Iris Pulse
palette.role: Violet action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments.

palette.name: Iris Border
palette.role: Card border outlines, subtle surface edges on dark mode — keeps card perimeters defined without breaking the violet mood

palette.name: Iris Veil
palette.role: Body and card border accent, secondary surface outline — lighter violet for hairline separators on dark surfaces

palette.name: Lilac Mist
palette.role: Line-art illustration stroke, decorative SVG fills, wireframe graphics — soft violet for technical/medical illustration overlay

palette.name: Clinical Cyan
palette.role: Data highlights, chart strokes, icon accents, inline links, interactive borders — the primary data-viz and link color across the UI

palette.name: Cyan Soft
palette.role: Secondary cyan accent, softer data labels, gradient endpoints paired with Clinical Cyan

palette.name: Mint Vital
palette.role: Green outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

palette.name: Teal Signal
palette.role: Highlight accent for key data callouts and chart emphasis — brighter teal-cyan for moments that need to pop

palette.name: Cloud White
palette.role: Primary text, button text on dark, button backgrounds in light section, high-contrast headings

palette.name: Pearl
palette.role: Soft icon strokes, subtle dividers, and low-emphasis decorative details. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Ash
palette.role: Muted text on light sections, secondary borders, low-emphasis labels

palette.name: Fog
palette.role: Hairline dividers, disabled borders, low-contrast separators
